(x + 1)dy = ((x + 1)2 + y – 3)dx

en.content:
Water flows in a horizontal tube (see figure).
The pressure of water changes by 700 Nm–2
between A and B where the area of cross section
are 40 cm2 and 20 cm2, respectively. Find the
rate of flow of water through the tube.
(density of water = 1000 kgm–3)
en.explanation:
Rate of flow of water is same at both A and B

AAVA = ABVB

(40)VA = (20)VB

VB = 2VA .......(1)

Using Bernoulli's theorem

PA + = PB +

PA - PB = -

700 =

VA = 0.68 m/s = 68 cm/s

Flow rate = AAVA = (40)(68) = 2720 cm3/s

ए और बी के बीच पानी के दबाव में 700 Nm–2 का
परिवर्तन होता है जहाँ क्रॉस सेक्शन के क्षेत्रफल
क्रमशः 40 cm2 और 20 cm2 हैं। ट्यूब के माध्यम से पानी के बहाव की दर ज्ञात करें।
(पानी की घनत्व = 1000 kgm–3)
